messages:
Lia: Heads up — planning intake for an external pentest on Tue 2024-12-05. We need a short ops window, KMS access plan for evidence, and clarity on RBAC changes. Who can own the access timeline?
Sam: I can own the ops window. Two asks: 1) ephemeral roles with audit logging enabled, 2) presigned locations for evidence ingestion.
Maria: For KMS, we should avoid handing out raw CMK access. Proposal: ops wraps artifacts with the customer-managed key (CMK) server-side using a wrap/unwrap flow, not raw decrypt. Assessors get presigned S3 puts; ops performs wrap step after upload.
Jon: That makes sense. Quick sketch of steps: 1) assessor presigns S3 PUT -> upload -> 2) ops runs `aws kms encrypt --key-id alias/pt-evidence --plaintext fileb://artifact.tar.gz` -> store encrypted artifact in evidence-bucket/encrypted/.
Maria: Exactly. Example command for ops (we'll script it):
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-pt-ingest/assessor-uploads/artifact.tar.gz --expires-in 3600
# after upload
aws kms encrypt --key-id arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd1234 --plaintext fileb://artifact.tar.gz --output text --query CiphertextBlob | base64 --decode > artifact.tar.gz.enc
```
Lia: Important: we need audit logs that prove who triggered the encrypt step. KMS CloudTrail events plus S3 access logs should be preserved and exported. Retention at least 90 days for the engagement.
Sam: Ops can enable Data Events logging for the bucket and ensure CloudTrail is in the engagement log group. Maria, can you confirm the CMK policy will allow ops principal to Encrypt but not Decrypt?
Maria: Yes — ops role will have kms:Encrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:CreateGrant for the short-lived workflows. Decrypt is restricted to an evidence-recovery role used only during retest verification with multi-approval.
Jon: On RBAC mapping — we should generate a small matrix: assessor, ops-ingest, triage-reader, remediation-owner. Lia, can you drop the expected people IDs so I can map to Okta groups?
Lia: Assessor -> group:pt-assessors; Ops -> group:pt-ops; Triage -> group:sec-triage; Remediation -> group:eng-remediate. Also: we need an ephemeral jump role for the assessor that expires after 2h.
Sam: I'll schedule the window and the ephemeral role timing. Proposed timeline: 13:45 UTC ops opens presign & role, 14:00 UTC assessor begins, 16:00 UTC close, 16:15 UTC ops performs wrap and stores encrypted artifacts.
OpsBot: deploy-bot reserved calendar slot for external-pt-2024-12-05 14:00-16:00 UTC (ID: slot-8249) :calendar:
Lia: Evidence packaging notes — require a manifest.json with file checksums and a README describing test cases & timestamps. Hash algo: sha256. We want manifest signed by assessor GPG key if available.
Maria: Also capture system snapshots: `journalctl --since "2024-12-05 14:00" > syslog-snapshot.log` and tar relevant logs into artifact. Ops should collect a verification checklist post-wrap with CloudTrail event IDs.
Jon: For retest coordination: create a Jira epic PT-2024-DEC and subtask for evidence verification. Remediate owners should link fixes to that epic to track regression. We should block retest until evidence + CloudTrail proof is attached.
Sam: Agreed. I'll create the Jira and put the retest gating checklist as Acceptance Criteria. Lia, can you lead the triage call the morning after ingestion?
Lia: Yes — 09:00 UTC next day triage standup to bucket vulnerabilities and assign P1/P2. We'll ask security-eng to label fixes with `pt-blocker` if it needs blocking rollout.
Maria: One open question: do we trust presigned PUTs without additional request validation? Suggest adding a short-lived S3 prefix policy that limits content-type & max-size to reduce risk.
Sam: Good call. Ops will set an S3 PUT policy with content-length-range and required header x-pt-upload:true. We'll validate on ingest.
Lia: Last piece — incident response hooks. If assessor finds active compromise, they should escalate to #incidents immediately and include `incident:external-pt` tag. Triage will trigger IR playbook.
Jon: I'll add IR hook step to the Jira playbook. Also adding a regression alert to Redwood Optimize so we can detect quality regressions after patches.
Sam: Locking the timeline and roles today. I'll post final runbook in this thread by EOD and add the calendar invite. :lock:
Lia: Thanks everyone. Small follow-up: Sam can you paste the Okta group IDs when you create the roles so we can automate the grant creation?
Sam: Will do. Follow-up note: calendar slot & Jira epic created, I'll paste links in thread shortly.
